title: PUBG Mobile Vehicle Skin Cards: Compatibility and Redemption Checks
summary: Understand why a PUBG Mobile car skin, vehicle type and redemption card are not interchangeable.
intro: Sports-car collaborations can be visually impressive, but a screenshot of a branded vehicle does not tell you whether a card can be redeemed on a particular account. Read the live event rules and item descriptions before attempting a purchase or exchange.

sections.heading: Distinguish a card from a vehicle appearance
paragraphs: An event can display vehicles, exchange materials, preview models and redeemable cosmetics in different screens. A card or token in inventory is not necessarily the finished vehicle skin, and a preview does not prove that a player owns the item. Check the exact reward name and how it is obtained. Some events use time-limited material or require additional steps before redemption. The word car card is not a standard promise that every collaboration or vehicle model can be claimed with the same item.
points: Write down the official item name before discussing compatibility.
Confirm whether the reward is an inventory item or a preview.

sections.heading: Match the intended vehicle category
paragraphs: Vehicle finishes are often tied to a particular in-game vehicle type or collaboration set. A sedan appearance, sports-car appearance and special lobby display should not be assumed interchangeable. Read the current event interface for compatible vehicles, variants and redemption rules. Do not infer compatibility solely because two cars look similar in promotional artwork. If a friend claims one card works for every brand, ask for a current official event explanation instead of relying on an edited image. Variants may have separate requirements even within one campaign.
points: Check compatibility in the game's own preview or redemption screen.
Separate exterior color variants from completely different vehicle models.

sections.heading: Identify the actual cost and expiry
paragraphs: Review how the card is obtained, whether additional currency is required and whether any material expires. A top-up or draw may provide a chance of receiving a redemption resource rather than the final skin itself. If a purchase involves randomness, follow the event's displayed probability and guarantee rules; do not rely on a seller's repeated lucky results. Check the end date for the event and any later claim window. A card that cannot be redeemed after an event closes may have little value to your intended plan.
points: Read the expiry dates before spending.
Do not assume partial collection progress guarantees the finished vehicle.

sections.heading: Protect your account while verifying
paragraphs: A genuine item check does not require giving a stranger your password, recovery email or two-factor authentication code. Screen recordings can help document what is visible in an inventory, but they do not eliminate account-transfer risks. PUBG Mobile's published terms prohibit account transfers, and unauthorized purchasing services can create further problems. Avoid modifications that replace local textures to imitate ownership of a rare car. Such changes cannot confer a valid item entitlement and may trigger account penalties or security issues.
points: Use only officially supported purchase and redemption channels.
Do not post private identifiers in screenshots offered as proof.

sections.heading: Create a decision record
paragraphs: Before committing to a cosmetic goal, record the item name, compatible vehicle type, required material, available currency, redemption steps and expiry. Compare the actual appearance in normal gameplay if the game provides a preview. Decide whether the expense fits your entertainment budget and avoid chasing a draw because you already spent on earlier attempts. If any field is unclear, wait for the official interface or support response rather than guessing. Specific, verifiable descriptions help collectors and prevent misunderstanding of promotional images.
points: Set a maximum spend before entering any random draw.
Keep a screenshot of the current redemption rules for reference.
